source:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: TEST
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID]
input: {SRC: source.csv}
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, VAL]}
columns:
  - {name: STUDYID, type: str, label: Study, derivation: SRC.StudyOID}
  - {name: USUBJID, type: str, label: Subject, derivation: SRC.SubjectKey}
  - {name: VAL, type: str, label: Value, derivation: {odm: SRC.IT.TEST.OID}}
rows:
  - id: occurrence
    dataset: SRC
    filter: "SRC.ItemOID = 'IT.ANCHOR'"
    derivations:
      STUDYID: SRC.StudyOID
      USUBJID: SRC.SubjectKey
